svg.title: ViFi one-time customer-care SMS opt-in flow
svg.desc: After a fresh phone-follow-up request and voice instruction, ViFi sends no SMS before a consumer texts YES. YES authorizes one opt-in confirmation and one fixed ViFi customer-care receipt. STOP applies globally to the ViFi program and HELP provides ViFi support.
svg.text: ViFi Customer-Care SMS Opt-In Flow
ZERO outbound SMS before the consumer texts YES
Step 1 — Fresh phone-follow-up request and ViFi voice disclosure
2 messages after YES: opt-in confirmation + 1 customer-care receipt.
To opt in, text YES to the number called after hearing the disclosure.
Optional; not a condition of purchase. Msg & data rates may apply. STOP to opt out; HELP for help.
Terms: vifi dot us slash legal slash terms · Privacy: vifi dot us slash legal slash privacy
Step 2 — Consumer sends inbound YES
YES is the consent moment and a new one-shot consumer request.
A spoken answer, call, or page visit is not SMS consent.
Step 3 — Confirmation registered at Campaign submission
ViFi: Opt-in confirmed. You will receive one requested follow-up text.
Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help or STOP to opt out.
Sent only after the inbound YES.
Step 4 — One fixed ViFi customer-care receipt
ViFi: Your one-time phone follow-up request has been recorded.
Reply HELP for help or STOP to opt out. Msg & data rates may apply.
No variables, customer names, links, phone numbers, free-form text, or recurring messages.
Complete after the one receipt
No reminder, marketing, free-form reply, or message series.
STOP = global ViFi suppression
No program number may bypass the opt-out.
START/UNSTOP, then fresh instructed YES.
HELP = ViFi support
support@vifi.us · STOP remains available
No duplicate application-generated auto-reply.
Reviewer evidence only · coordinated test number +1 (678) 750-4279 after a fresh test call.
